gates.permutation_p_null: binomial P(K >= k | rate 0.05) >= 0.01 and chi-square GOF P over the B+1 values >= 0.01
gates.connectivity_null: upper95 P(P<=0.05) <= 0.10 and planted cluster P = 1/200
gates.blocked_permutation_p_null: binomial P(K >= k | rate 0.05) >= 0.01 and chi-square GOF P >= 0.01
gates.blocked_ungrouped_reference: mean ungrouped AUC - mean grouped AUC > 0.05

design: 15 vs 15 units, 200 pure-noise features; nested CV 2 x 5-fold outer, 3-fold inner, top-5 AUC selection, ridge glmnet lambda 0.1; leaky reference selects and scales on all data
network: 300 measured genes, 1500 random edges plus a planted complete cluster of 10 genes; random sets of 10 genes drawn uniformly from the measured universe; degree-preserving null of 199 draws
fit_path: production R functions: pd_bm_nested, pd_bm_permute_labels, pd_connectivity_null

blocked.design: 10 vs 10 subjects x 2 observations, subject effect SD 1 on each of 200 pure-noise features; nested CV grouped by subject 2 x 5-fold outer, 3-fold inner, top-5 AUC, ridge glmnet lambda 0.1; permutation of whole subjects; ungrouped reference uses observation-level folds

not_calibrated: LOOCV, lasso/elastic-net selection, SVM and random-forest classifiers, tuned lambda grids (fixed ridge lambda 0.1 and top-5 AUC selection only)
